Egypt archaeological discovery sheds new light on ancient Horus Military Road
description: article author: Fady Francis Author: Sun, 2026-08-16 13:42 CAIRO: An Egyptian archaeological mission has uncovered new evidence at Tell Abu Seifi in Qantara East, Ismailia Governorate, shedding fresh light on the ancient Horus Military Road and the city of Mesen. The discoveries include a lintel dating to the reign of King Ramesses II, new architectural evidence relating to the Temple of Horus, a headless and footless statue dating to the Late Period, the torso of a royal basalt statue, and fragments of falcon statues made from basalt and limestone. Main category: Middle East Tags: ancient history
